description: This file defines functions and types for parsing and handling JSON query results from QMD, including JSON parsing, validation, and utility functions for processing query output.

methods.name: parseQmdQueryJson
methods.description: Parses JSON output from QMD queries, handling errors and fallback parsing.

methods.name: isQmdNoResultsOutput
methods.description: Checks if the output indicates no results found.

methods.name: isQmdNoResultsLine
methods.description: Checks if a line explicitly states no results found.

methods.name: summarizeQmdStderr
methods.description: Summarizes stderr output, truncating if necessary.

methods.name: parseQmdQueryResultArray
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into an array of QmdQueryResult objects.

methods.name: parseQmdLineNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a line number if valid.

methods.name: extractFirstJsonArray
methods.description: Extracts the first JSON array from a raw string.
